description: Create a Peppol BIS 3 UBL, XRechnung (UBL or CII) or Factur-X/ZUGFeRD CII XML invoice from structured invoice data, with totals and VAT computed and the result validated. Uses one metered call. Requires an InvoiceVerify account (OAuth sign-in).

format.description: Output format. Default 'peppol' (Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 UBL).

invoice.description: Invoice data: {number, issueDate (YYYY-MM-DD), dueDate?, currency?, buyerReference?, seller: Party, buyer: Party, payment?: {meansCode, iban, bic}, lines: [{name, quantity, unitPrice, unitCode?, vatCategory? (S,Z,E,AE,K,G,O), vatRate?}]}. Party: {name, vatId?, companyId?, endpointId, endpointScheme (EAS code, e.g. 0208, 9930), street?, city?, postalCode?, country (ISO 2)}. Full schema: InvoiceData in /openapi.json.

name: generate_invoice
title: Generate e-invoice XML
